QuestInfo.0: Kaiser isn't just carrying luggage after all. He's helping #b#p3000002##k with the development of the Blue Dragon Cannon. At least it's not the worst job ever. Go see #b#p3000002##k.
QuestInfo.1: The development of the Blue Dragon Cannon is going well thanks to Kaiser, and your next job is to eliminate some #o2400103# monsters. Looks Kaiser isn't the only one being underutilized... Just collect #b50 #t4000742##k items from the  #o2400103# monsters at the #r#m401030000##k to get it over with.
QuestInfo.2: While Kaiser helped out with the development of the Blue Dragon Cannon, you helped out with the research on the #o2400103#. If you didn't do it, Kaiser probably would've had to do it... So you WERE a help! Yay for Angelic Buster!
